use_cases: Displaying product information with multiple images and color variants in e-commerce storefronts
Interactive product showcase with hover-triggered image transitions on catalog pages
Product recommendation widgets with color and style variations
Shopping cart previews with visual product details
Landing page product highlights with animated imagery
ai_summary: An interactive product card component featuring color variant selection and smooth hover-triggered image switching animations using Framer Motion. Supports multiple product images per color with opacity-based transitions, ideal for e-commerce product displays, catalogs, and shopping interfaces.
